hypotheses.W0_weight_path_jvps_recompose: The sum of independently derived path JVPs matches the simultaneous token-embedding JVP to relative error at most 1e-5 for operator and logits.
hypotheses.W1_one_percent_edit_is_locally_linear: The total weight JVP reproduces a 0.01x finite edit with at least 0.99 operator and Fisher fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.W2_full_token_edit_is_materially_nonline: Full-edit operator or Fisher JVP fidelity is at least 0.10 below its 0.01x value on every corpus.
hypotheses.W3_repeated_injection_dominates_local_se: The six repeated-injection groups jointly receive at least 0.80 projection share in both operator and Fisher geometry on every corpus.
hypotheses.W4_initial_and_bus_are_minor_local_paths: Initial plus bus projection share is at most 0.20 in both operator and Fisher geometry on every corpus.
hypotheses.W5_layers_0_through_11_capture_most_loca: Injection groups 0-11 reproduce at least 0.80 of the all-injection local effect in operator and Fisher geometry on every corpus.
hypotheses.W6_layers_15_through_17_are_locally_mino: The Layer-15-17 injection group has absolute projection share at most 0.10 in both metrics on every corpus.
hypotheses.W7_injection_dominance_is_metric_robust: Total injection projection shares differ by at most 0.10 between operator and Fisher metrics on every corpus.
hypotheses.W8_injection_dominance_transfers_ood: Total injection projection share ranges by at most 0.15 across corpora in each metric.
hypotheses.W9_true_token_loss_uses_the_injection_pa: Repeated-injection groups receive positive aggregate projection share for the true-token CE derivative on every corpus.
hypotheses.W10_equal_direct_coefficients_do_not_imp: The range of three-layer injection-group projection shares is at least 0.10 in at least one metric on every corpus.
